Ready to keep things moving behind the scenes at Søstrene Grene? We’re looking for an Inbound Logistics Associate to join our warehouse team! You’ll be accurately counting incoming goods, sorting mixed pallets, scanning stock into our system, and keeping everything replenished with an EPT or Reachtruck—no worries if you haven't driven one before, we offer internal training! Working in a convenient 2-shift rotation, you can earn up to €19.80 per hour while keeping our operations running smoothly in a warm, friendly environment. Sounds like a fit? Join us today!

What we offer
- Earn up to €19.80 per hour!
- More experience means a higher salary
- Budget-friendly lunch on early shifts
- Free breakfast every Tuesday & Thursday
- Short breaks are fully paid
- No strict uniform—wear your own comfy clothes!

Who you are
As our Inbound and Sorting Specialist, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You can work in a 2 shift system ( 7.00-15.00 / 15.00 - 23.00 )
- You have your own transport to work in Sevenum/Venlo
- You are full time available
- You understand and speak English

What will you do
As our new Inbound Logistics Associate, your main mission is to welcome all the beautiful Søstrene Grene goods into our warehouse! You'll be sorting through mixed pallets packed with everything from charming home decor, cozy textiles, and creative craft supplies to sleek kitchenware and cute stationery. Armed with a simple scanner and an eye for numbers, you’ll count incoming stock, log it into our system, and keep our shelves fully stocked using an EPT or Reachtruck. It’s hands-on, satisfying work where you get to be the very first person to handle our latest Scandinavian design collections!

Do you like working in a fast-paced environment and do you want to earn a good salary? Join UPS in Venlo! As a Logistic Employee you will help ship important medical products that save lives. You will earn up to €19.25 per hour (including allowances) and you get paid every week 💸. The job features a clear 2-shift schedule, with many opportunities to grow a career in international logistics. Ready to start? Apply now! 🚀#baanrader

What we offer
- Salary of €15.40 gross per hour! 💸
- Evening allowance after 19:00 = €19.25 per hour!
- A long-term job!
- Travel allowance starting from 10 km! 🚗
- International career growth opportunities! 📈
- Weekly salary!

Who you are
As a Logistic Employee at UPS Venlo, you are proactive and enjoy physical work. You work accurately and take responsibility for your tasks. You also meet the following criteria:

- You speak and understand English well (the primary language at work). 🗣️
- You are full-time available for 40 hours per week.
- You are 5 days a week available from Monday to Friday.
- You are ready to work in a 2-shift system: 06:00-15:00 and 15:00-00:00. 🕒
- Have your own transport to reach the work location in Venlo. 🚗
- You are willing to working in a cold environment (you receive an extra €80 per month allowance for this). ❄️

What will you do
Roll up your sleeves and make a difference at UPS in Venlo! 🚀 As a Logistic Employee you are the key to accurately picking, scanning, and checking life-saving medical packages. You ensure every order is perfectly ready for shipment and take charge of loading and unloading freight.

To keep the vital medical products safe, you will regularly work in a cold environment. Cold? Don’t worry! We’ve got you covered with a warm jacket! It’s a physical challenge with real impact and great team spirit. ❄️🧥

Your tasks in a nutshell:

- Picking medical products
- Scanning and checking shipments
- Preparing orders for dispatch
- Loading and unloading freight

Are you looking for ultimate freedom on the road and weekly payments in your bank account? As a Delivery Driver AH Online in Amsterdam, you will enjoy independence and a great starting salary. Step into your office on wheels and make countless customers happy! 🚚💨💸

Job application

Are you searching for an opportunity to showcase your expertise as a reachtruck driver in a company where you stand a chance of securing a contract? Look no further, as we have the perfect position for you at Kuehne + Nagel in Veghel. This role offers a 5 shift system in which you work 2 mornings, 2 afternoons, 2 nights and then 4 days off!  Want quick job security? If you do a good job, you could get a permanent contract after 10 weeks!

What we offer
- Starting salary at €14,99!

- Travel allowance of up to €10.50 per day.
- Joining a dynamic and supportive team!

- Room for advancement within the company

Who you are
As a reachtruck driver at Kuehne + Nagel, you:

- Are proficient in Dutch or English
- Hold a valid reach truck certification
- Can commit to working 2 mornings, 2 afternoons and 2 nights (then 4 days off!)
- Are able to come to work by own transport (car/bike)

What will you do
As a reach truck driver, you'll kickstart your day within the Netherlands' finest team. Working in an enjoyable environment is a guarantee. And what's better than ending your day on a high note! You'll handle products for renowned brands. Does the name Mars ring a bell? ;-) It's just one of the many prominent names you'll be working with.

Where will you work
Kuehne + Nagel is a global leader in transportation and logistics, and it's also a remarkably pleasant place to work! Your future colleagues have praise for the company – and that matters, doesn't it? In Veghel, you'll serve various prestigious clients, including Mars

A job in the early morning, so you have plenty of time left for your hobbies in the rest of the afternoon! Or for groceries, perhaps 😉. As a warehouse employee at PostNL in Westzaan, your shift starts at 05:00! So, it's for the real early birds. Additionally, PostNL Westzaan is a real #baanrader. They score an 8+ for job satisfaction! Want to know more? Read this vacancy quickly.

What we offer
- Salary of €14,99 gross per hour!
- Working before 06:00? Get an extra 30%!
- 40% Saturday bonus: €20,98 per hour!
- Travel allowance from 6 km!
- Weekly payments!
- Afternoons and evenings are free!

Who you are
As a warehouse employee, you're active in the early morning! You never get out of bed on the wrong side. We don't ask for much, but we do require the following:

- You are at least 3 days available per week
- You are available from Monday to Saturday
- You are available from 05:00 - 13:00

You will ensure that the packages get to the delivery vans! As a warehouse employee, you're constantly on the move. In the morning, trucks full of packages arrive. Then the packages are sorted via a conveyor belt, and the deliverers can load their own vans. On to the customers!

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can be delivered to customers on time.

Your responsibilities include placing packages on the sorting conveyor belt, processing sorted shipments, and supporting the daily logistics operation. You will work Monday to Friday and be available 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Start and end times may vary.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier or difficult to lift, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center

In addition, you will carry out quality inspections and accurately record production data.

In this role, you'll work closely with colleagues from production, logistics, and the technical department. Maintaining high standards of hygiene, safety, and quality is an essential part of the job and the working environment.

- A team player

"An empty fridge doesn't make anyone happy, right?" As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you make sure customers get their favorite snacks, breakfast and groceries delivered right to their door. On top of that, you’ll score an all-in hourly wage of €18.83. Ka-chinggg!

With you behind the wheel, every delivery becomes a party! And you get paid well for it  too. With flexible working hours, almost anything is possible.

Want to know more? Read on to check out the rest of the job opening!

What we offer
- A great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks
- Standard 8.33% holiday allowance to do fun things
- Plenty of holiday days for your well-deserved rest
- Access to helpful training courses to keep growing
- Freedom on the road with a truck full of goodies
- Guaranteed pension accrual from your first workday

Who you are
As an Albert Heijn delivery driver, you deliver groceries right to the customer's front door. You are physically fit and have no problem lifting crates. You can also easily step in and out of the delivery van on a regular basis.

In addition, you bring the following to the table:

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You have your own transportation to get to Heyderweg 2-6 in Leiden.
- You hold a valid category B driver's license.

What will you do
From well-known cities to tiny villages you didn't even know existed: that is what awaits you as an Albert Heijn delivery driver. Every day is different. Some days your workday runs smoothly, and other days you run into obstacles—like an apartment building without an elevator or a house number that's nowhere to be found. You’ll experience it all.

Fortunately, you are well-prepared during your onboarding period and you know how to keep a cool head! There are also plenty of opportunities to grow. For instance, you can quickly start working as a buddy, guiding and training new employees. Or you can become a plusser, making sure every driver hits the road fully equipped with all the essentials.

- Working days:

Challenge, growth opportunities, and a good salary of €18,83 as a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you get it all! 🚀🤑 Every day is different, with new routes and obstacles, which makes your job challenging and fun! And, there is a lot in return. Think of the many happy faces of customers when you arrive with your delivery van at their doorstep! 🚚

Curious about what other benefits you can expect? Read on! 👀

What we offer
- Earn € 18,83 per hour (from age 21)!
- A chance to get a contract with Albert Heijn!
- An informal work environment!
- Plan your own shifts via the app!
- Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, up to 45 km!
- Nice growth opportunities at Albert Heijn!

Who you are
As a delivery driver, your social skills come in very handy: you will be in touch with customers a lot! 😊 Also, physical work is no problem for you, such as lifting crates up to fifteen kilos. 💪 Additionally, you meet the following requirements:

- You have a valid B driving license (Min 2 Year)🚗
- You speak Dutch or English, or both
- You have transport to get to our location at Siegenstraat 7 in Zwolle 🚗🚲

What will you do
As a delivery driver, you will deliver groceries at customers' houses! 🍉🥦🧀 Also, you complete the payments and take empty bottles with you. While driving around in your own van, you may encounter challenges. Like a building without an elevator or a hard-to-find house number. This makes your work varied and exciting! #baanrader 🤩 Fortunately, you’ll be well-prepared: you start your job with an extensive training guided by a buddy.
